posts.title: The Luxury of Focus | Serbia Open
posts.description: Every chess player knows the tension that has nothing to do with the position on the board. Serbia Open, the international chess festival in Belgrade, took that tension away. A review of what the 2026 edition looked like from the inside, and why it deserves a place on your calendar for next year.
